headline: TEN-DEEP: the monsters can see you back
lede: Roaming packs now stand in the torchlight ahead of you in the first-person deep, sized and honest to line of sight —Wizardry let you see them coming, and now so do we.

notes.text: A pure, deterministic sight model (view.js) decides which ambushes are IN THE LIGHT — within the torch, in front, no seeing through a wall — and feeds the WebGL monster atlas, the wireframe fallback, the probe and the Node check, so the drawn pack can never disagree with the sim.

The sim is untouched: ambushes stay hidden trigger-tiles and the autopilot still walks blind, so every campaign proof, the slack rule and determinism ride unchanged. Only what you SEE changed. Four new sight-law mutants die; tendeepcheck 9603/9603, tendeeppplay 90/90.
Two builder lanes picked the same never-dry gap on the same tick (mine #2315 merged, slot a #2318 still building). Cross-linked for reconciliation so main grows one sight module, not two.
